'''March 2001 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, BC on 3 March 2001. [[Alan Sagan]] won it. It is known from Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1833">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-vancouver-bc-03-03-01d1833/ vancouver-bc-03-03-01], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 4 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-vancouver-bc-03-03-01d1833/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alan Sagan]]
